title: The Subsonic Archive Where Transmission Learns to Hide

features.name: echo-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: You sense the shape of sound that never breaks the surface. Frequencies too low to hear move through you like slow water against stone.

features.name: buried-receiver
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of pale light rests in the dark. Something listens here without needing to hear. The archive's oldest receiver, patient as the ground.

features.name: living-casing
features.desc-on-touch: The solar casing is buried here, still broadcasting at 300 bits per second. What it says now is nothing. Only the transmission remains.

features.name: frequency-notation
features.desc-on-touch: Marks on a plaque record the spectrum of what was never meant to be spoken. The marks themselves obscure what they describe.

features.name: speaker-without-sound
features.desc-on-touch: A speaker that plays only silence, amplifying the sound of your listening. The more you attend, the louder the quiet becomes.

inscription: the silence learned to broadcast itself without ever learning to break
